categories.label: Contract or boundary review
categories.description: The observed span, detector boundary, or comparison contract needs a maintainer decision.
categories.nextAction: Re-run the fixture, compare authored ranges, and record the contract decision in a pull request.

categories.label: Product defect candidate
categories.description: Reviewed benchmark metadata identifies a repeatable product behavior that may need a product issue.
categories.nextAction: Confirm the current observation, link or open the product issue, then record the reviewed decision.

categories.label: Fixture or expectation review
categories.description: The authored fixture truth or expectation is not yet strong enough for an automatic assertion.
categories.nextAction: Review the authored bytes and expectation source before changing either the fixture or ledger.

categories.label: Intentional difference / not assertable
categories.description: The scanners may intentionally differ; peer output remains review evidence, not ground truth.
categories.nextAction: Check the documented scanner contracts and record a class-level not-assertable decision when justified.
